activities.title: Breakfast Roundtable (Africa Tech Summit)
activities.description: Breakfast roundtable at Africa Tech Summit focused on AI in agriculture, food, and climate; market intelligence + discussion.
activities.fullDescription:
Held during Africa Tech Summit in Nairobi, this roundtable brought together founders and ecosystem stakeholders to discuss where AI can deliver real value in agriculture, food, and climate.

Conversations emphasized that data may exist but is often not ready for AI, and that founders benefit from support to clearly frame problems, define use cases, and move from ideas to implementation.
highlights: A breakfast roundtable at Africa Tech Summit in Nairobi, focused on practical AI use cases and the foundations needed for adoption.

activities.title: Webinar — Founders’ Circle: AI in AgTech
activities.description: Founders’ Circle webinar featuring founders from Rhea Soil (Priscilla Wakarera) and Farm2Feed (Anouk Boertien) sharing AI learnings and hackathon experience.
activities.fullDescription:
This Founders’ Circle brought together entrepreneurs to share practical lessons on implementing AI and navigating product, data, and execution challenges.

Founders exchanged concrete takeaways from their own journeys and discussed what it means to build AI solutions that work across diverse African contexts.
highlights: A founders-led conversation sharing practical lessons on building with AI—across different African markets.

activities.title: Webinar — Agentic AI Strategies
activities.description: Capacity-building webinar on Agentic AI strategies in AgTech and Climate Tech, featuring Willy Bogonko (Mastercard).
activities.fullDescription:
This online session explored Agentic AI strategies and how they can support founders in building more autonomous, efficient processes.

Designed for a non-technical audience, the webinar focused on translating concepts into concrete business use cases and helped participants identify where agent-like systems could create value in their operations.
highlights: A practical webinar exploring Agentic AI—what it is, why it matters, and how founders can apply it in real workflows.

activities.title: Webinar — Ag + Climate AI
activities.description: Capacity-building webinar introducing AI in AgTech and Climate Tech, led by Leonida Mutuku (Local Development Research Institute).
activities.fullDescription:
This online session introduced real-world AI use cases in AgTech and Climate Tech, with an emphasis on how founders can move from experimentation to impact.

The discussion also addressed common barriers—such as limited access to structured data, talent, and resources—and shared practical ways to start building AI-enabled products.
highlights: An introductory webinar showcasing practical AI applications in AgTech and Climate Tech—and what it takes to get started.

activities.title: Johannesburg Founders Day — Capacity Building
activities.description: Capacity-building sessions during WWBA Founders Day in Johannesburg with AI-focused breakouts for ag & climate founders.
activities.fullDescription:
These Johannesburg capacity-building sessions supported women founders with practical guidance on applying AI in agtech and climate tech.

Participants explored how to translate business challenges into AI opportunities, what “AI-ready” data looks like, and how to think about responsible AI—while connecting with peers and practitioners.
highlights: Interactive sessions in Johannesburg helping women founders build the skills and confidence to move from AI ideas to real implementation.

activities.title: Accra Networking Dinner
activities.description: Networking dinner in Accra for women founders, investors, and ecosystem partners across food/ag, climate, and energy; discussion on localization and culture shaping AI adoption.
activities.fullDescription:
This Accra dinner convened women founders, investors, and ecosystem partners across food/ag, climate, and energy to exchange experiences and build trust-based connections.

Discussions highlighted the importance of tailoring AI solutions to local realities and the value of cross-market networks to help founders learn, partner, and scale.
highlights: A curated dinner in Accra bringing together women founders and ecosystem leaders to discuss AI adoption, local context, and cross-market collaboration.

activities.title: Nairobi Founders Day — Capacity Building
activities.description: Capacity-building sessions delivered during WWBA Founders Day focused on AI + data for ag & climate founders.
activities.fullDescription:
These capacity-building sessions supported women founders working in agtech and climate tech to better understand how AI can create value for their businesses.

The program covered how to identify relevant use cases, prepare data for AI projects, and approach responsible AI and investment readiness—through interactive discussions and applied examples.
highlights: Hands-on learning sessions in Nairobi designed to help women founders turn AI curiosity into practical, business-ready projects.

activities.title: Nairobi Founders Day — Networking Cocktail
activities.description: Networking cocktail following WWBA Founders Day in Nairobi, connecting founders with investors and ecosystem partners.
activities.fullDescription:
This networking cocktail offered a dedicated space for women founders, investors, and ecosystem partners to meet, connect, and continue conversations started during the Founders Day sessions.

The goal was to foster new relationships and spark follow-up opportunities for collaboration within the AI4Startups community.
highlights: A networking moment in Nairobi to help women founders connect with investors and ecosystem partners after a full day of learning.

activities.title: Johannesburg Founders Day — Networking Cocktail
activities.description: Networking cocktail following WWBA Founders Day in Johannesburg.
activities.fullDescription:
This networking cocktail created an informal setting for women founders, investors, and ecosystem actors to connect and build relationships.

It helped extend the Founders Day experience beyond the sessions, encouraging peer exchange and follow-up conversations within the AI4Startups community.
highlights: An evening networking cocktail in Johannesburg to connect women founders with investors and ecosystem partners.

activities.title: Nairobi Networking Event
activities.description: Networking event to introduce AI4Startups and connect women founders, investors, and ecosystem partners in ag & climate.
activities.fullDescription:
This Nairobi networking evening connected women founders, investors, and ecosystem partners to discuss practical opportunities for AI in agriculture and climate-focused innovation.

Through informal conversations and peer exchange, participants shared current challenges, emerging use cases, and collaboration opportunities—helping strengthen the AI4Startups community locally.

location.venue: Crafty Chameleon Brewhouse and Restaurant (159 James Gichuru Road)

highlights: An in-person networking evening in Nairobi bringing together women founders, investors, and ecosystem leaders to explore how AI can support agriculture innovation.

activities.title: Data Without Borders — Abidjan (Event)
activities.description: Data Without Borders day in Abidjan: dialogue between startups, regulators, and experts on barriers to data sharing and actionable solutions.
activities.fullDescription:
Data Without Borders in Abidjan convened startups, regulators, and ecosystem leaders to discuss how better data access and data sharing can accelerate AI innovation.

Building on insights from a startup workshop held in advance, the day focused on practical dialogue: clarifying challenges, sharing perspectives, and identifying actionable pathways—grounded in trust, standards, and governance.
highlights: A multi-stakeholder day in Abidjan bringing together startups, regulators, and experts to unlock data as a growth lever for AI innovation.

activities.title: Data Without Borders — Online Workshop (Startups)
activities.description: Online workshop (startups) ahead of the Data Without Borders event to identify barriers to data sharing/usage and co-design solution pathways.
activities.fullDescription:
Ahead of Data Without Borders, this online workshop brought together a small group of startups to discuss the day-to-day challenges of accessing, using, and sharing data.

Through a participatory format, founders shared concrete examples and explored solution pathways—highlighting the importance of trust, clearer frameworks, and stronger collaboration across the data ecosystem.
highlights: A focused online workshop with startups to surface real barriers to data access and sharing—and explore practical ways forward.

activities.title: Data & Regulatory Landscape study (Patrick Cage)
activities.description: Study on data & regulatory landscape for data sharing across AI4SU scope countries, including survey + qualitative interviews and country-by-country legal mapping.
activities.fullDescription:
Patrick Cage delivered a Data & Regulatory Landscape study for AI4SU to support safer, more consistent data sharing practices across the programme’s scope countries.

The study combined:
- A structured survey with startups and ecosystem actors.
- Qualitative interviews to deepen understanding of constraints, incentives, and real-world practices.
- A country-by-country mapping of the legal and regulatory frameworks relevant to data access, data sharing, privacy, and compliance.

The work aimed to:
- Identify practical regulatory and compliance considerations for startups and data providers.
- Highlight key differences across countries and what they imply for cross-border data use.
- Provide recommendations and usable insights for programme activities (including hackathons and open-source outputs).

Main deliverables:
- Survey instrument + consolidated dataset of responses (for annex use).
- Interview insights.
- Final report including per-country legal mapping and recommendations.

Format: Online / remote research and analysis over the reporting period.
highlights: Survey + interviews + country mapping delivered as a final study/report.

activities.title: Ecosystem mapping Study (Briter)
activities.description: Ecosystem mapping study (survey + qualitative interviews) to document the data/AI ecosystem and produce actionable insights.
activities.fullDescription:
Briter delivered an ecosystem mapping study for AI4SU, combining (i) a survey and (ii) qualitative interviews to document the data/AI ecosystem and extract actionable insights for the programme.

The work focused on:
- Building a clear picture of the ecosystem (key actors, dynamics, constraints).
- Surfacing concrete barriers and enablers for African startups to access and use data.
- Producing a written report synthesizing findings and recommendations.

Main deliverables:
- Survey instrument + dataset of responses.
- Interview guide + qualitative insights.
- Final report (ecosystem mapping study) with key learnings and recommendations.

Format: Online / remote research and analysis over the reporting period.
highlights: Ecosystem mapping study delivered (survey + interviews + report).

womenFounders.title: Women Founders Program
womenFounders.tagline: Empowering women entrepreneurs to lead Africa's AI revolution
womenFounders.description: The Women Founders Program provides targeted support for women building AI-powered startups across Africa. Through bootcamps, mentorship, funding access, and community, we're closing the gender gap in African tech.

programElements.title: Bootcamps
programElements.description: Intensive 5-day programs combining technical AI training with business development.

programElements.title: Mentorship
programElements.description: One-on-one mentorship from successful women founders and tech leaders.

programElements.title: Funding Access
programElements.description: Pitch opportunities, investor introductions, and grant access.

programElements.title: Community
programElements.description: Ongoing peer support through the Women Founders Network.

programDescription: The Women Founders Program is a dedicated initiative within AI4Startups designed to address the gender gap in African tech. Through intensive bootcamps, one-on-one mentorship, investor introductions, and community support, we're helping women entrepreneurs build and scale AI-powered startups.

Program participants receive technical training, business development support, cloud credits, and access to our network of successful founders and investors. The program has supported over 120 women across 8 African countries, with 15 startups receiving follow-on funding.
